mechanism_narrative: When WORKPLACES and TRANSIT move up from their recent troughs, weekday foot traffic returns to city centers and retail trips increase within four weeks. If commuting remains depressed, RETAIL_REC will stay below the prior four-week average.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES fell to -51.6 then rebounded to -46.3; TRANSIT remained around -39 to -42
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise above its last-4-week mean over the next 28 days despite a sustained 2-week increase in both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp weekly drop in PARKS signals substitution toward indoor consumer activity, which lifts retail and recreation within one to two weeks. If park visits do not weaken further, this short-run boost in RETAIL_REC will not materialize.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls below -10 on a weekly mean
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS moved from -3.6 to -9.6 before recovering to -7.9
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to improve within 14 days after PARKS crosses below -10 and remains there for at least one week.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in RESIDENTIAL time alongside weak TRANSIT indicates stay-at-home behavior that suppresses discretionary retail visits over the next four weeks. If people are moving out of home more often, the drag on RETAIL_REC disappears.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL stayed elevated around 9 points while TRANSIT stayed near -40
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its last-4-week mean over the next 28 days even though RESIDENTIAL stays elevated and TRANSIT remains depressed.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM and RETAIL_REC both rebound from a prior dip, it indicates broader reopening or easing of mobility constraints that spills into higher retail-and-recreation activity over the next month. A renewed decline in grocery trips would remove that support.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM turns upward after a weekly decline of at least 3 points
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM improved from -21.4 to -16.6 while RETAIL_REC improved from -44.9 to -41.4
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve over the next 28 days after GROCERY_PHARM reverses upward from a weekly decline of at least 3 points.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated PARKS activity during warm-season weeks competes with retail trips, so stronger park use will hold RETAIL_REC down over the next two weeks. If park mobility remains flat or falls, the seasonal diversion effect will not appear.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS was closest to zero at -3.6 before weakening to -9.6
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises within 14 days after PARKS moves above -5 and stays above that threshold for a full week.

mechanism_narrative: A synchronized improvement in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES signals a broad return of routine mobility that should lift retail-and-recreation demand over the next four weeks. If only one of the two improves, the retail effect will be smaller or absent.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both remain deeply negative, near -39 and -46
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC stays below its last-4-week mean over the next 28 days even though TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both trend upward for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT improves by more than 3 points week on week, it marks a loosening in commuting friction that feeds through quickly to retail visits within one week. If transit stalls, the signal will not convert into stronger RETAIL_REC.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises by more than 3 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved from -42.3 to -39.1 in the latest week after several weeks near -39 to -42
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve in the following week after TRANSIT rises by more than 3 points week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in RESIDENTIAL and decline in WORKPLACES indicates substitution toward home-based routines that reduces discretionary shopping over the next month. If office attendance recovers at the same time, the negative effect on retail will fail.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL stayed positive near 9 while WORKPLACES fell to -51.6 before rebounding only slightly
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases above its last-4-week mean over the next 28 days even though RESIDENTIAL remains elevated and WORKPLACES remains below -40.
